prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production TRANSPARENT pixel-art animation atlas for a Japanese shrine-maiden summoner in a polished arcade/JRPG side-scrolling idle RPG. Reference image is locked pixel shading and palette guidance only unless identified as SAME SUBJECT. Deliberate clean square pixel clusters, dark crisp colored outlines, ivory highlights, violet-grey shadows, vermilion/white/gold shrine accents; no smooth illustration, painted gradients, blur or 3D. Real transparent RGBA, no painted checkerboard, floor, cast shadow, text, border, labels, separators or grid. All frame silhouettes fully inside x=.10..90,y=.10..90 with wide EMPTY transparent gutters. Same scale, camera, anatomy and palette across cells. Create exactly 4 frames in ONE horizontal row of equally sized square cells. Subject: ONE large sacred oni warrior spirit, ivory/red oni mask with exactly TWO short gold horns, charcoal-red lamellar torso armor, TWO spectral arms, ONE long ivory katana held by right hand, lower body tapering into red-white ribbons; translucent central torso with clear opening for a host. Full-body guardian spirit drawn without a human; keep central host channel transparent. Position: mask (.50,.25), shoulders (.35,.40)/(.65,.40), ribbon tips on .86. Idle loop: 1 exhale/relaxed; 2 chest/head rise one logical pixel and wings/tail lift two; 3 ease halfway back; 4 settle just before frame1. Feet stay planted for ground creatures, hover center stays fixed for flying.
